traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet. This combination is modern/cyclic only.

modern.blend: Order meets disruption. The clash of the established and the radical, the structured and the new.
modern.harmonious: You naturally do the new thing in a disciplined way, and the old thing with a fresh twist.
modern.hard: Restlessness fights control; each demands attention and sabotages the other until both are satisfied at once.
modern.business: Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.
